caption: The drawing features two separate bonnet-like objects rendered in fine pencil outline on an off-white or beige background. The larger object, positioned on the left, has an oval shape with visible seam lines running vertically and along the lower curved edge. There are two ribbon-like ties hanging down from the lower edge, and a small stitched or embroidered marking consisting of the letters "WA" is visible near the bottom seam. The smaller object, located to the right and slightly below the larger one, has a polygonal shape with slightly rounded edges and a similarly placed lower seam. It also features a pair of short, ribbon-like ties and a tiny stitched marking represented by a star or asterisk near its seam. Both objects are drawn with minimal shading and detail, emphasizing their outlines and construction. The composition is sparse, with ample empty space surrounding the two bonnet forms.
title: Man's Night Cap
